text:
felix: Hey runtime — marketing needs a compact reproducible bench pack to substantiate two bullets in the launch post and one webinar slide. Can we get a focused smoke run? :wave:
anya: Yep. What exact artifacts do you want?
felix: Minimal set: manifest with exact model checksum and run command, per_request CSV, small token-trace sample (6 requests), README with expected variance note, and a 1-slide PNG showing p50/p95/p99 for quick slide copy.
mona: Which model/quant/hardware and the qps/warmup we should use?
felix: Short demo: 256 tokens, model-tag=mkting-v2, h100-standard, int8 and fp16 variants. qps 60 for short. Long demo: 2048 tokens streaming and non-streaming @10qps. Warmup policy: 3 warmup windows. Use seed mkting-seed-2026 (I'll DM it).
ben: We'll include cache stats (hit rate) and mark whether prefix sharing was on. Also include coldstart traces explicitly if you want.
anya: Include both coldstart and steady-state for the short demo. For token traces, pick mixed-length requests so we cover tail behaviours.
mona: OK. Output bundle will be artifact_smoke.tar.gz with: manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_sample.csv, README.md, pstat_bars.png. README will have an example run command.
felix: Example run command in README please (so translators can paste into docs):
```
MODEL=mkting-v2 CHECKSUM=sha256:placeholder RUN_SEED=mkting-seed-2026 ./bench/smoke.sh --qps 60 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
ben: We will run int8 first, then fp16. If int4 is stable we'll include it as "experimental" and tag it. We'll also record GPU utilization and scheduler noise notes.
anya: Timeline? Need smoke pack by Tue 9am PT to lock the launch blurb. Full sweep can follow.
ops: Queued job 133722 on h100-standard pool. Estimated smoke runtime ~50m. Will upload to GCS when done.
felix: That works. Also please add a one-line caveat in README: "single-run smoke artifacts; expect ~±10% variability on p95 due to scheduler and cache effects."
ops: runtime-bot: job 133722 started.
ops: upload complete: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5187654321/smoke_pack.tar.gz (3.1MB). logs: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5187654321/logs/133722.log
felix: Got it, downloading now. If we need a quick rerun (adjust qps or toggle prefix cache) we'll request here.
anya: I'll sanity-check p95/p99 in the CSV and confirm whether numbers map to the wording in the blog. If variance >10% we'll ask for a rerun.
mona: If a rerun is requested we can typically turn around a single-variant change in ~30m.
ben: Leaving notes in the manifest about exact kernel flags and quantization libs used so the operations are reproducible.
runtime-bot: job 133722 finished successfully.
